results.name: ROYAL DANSK - Cookies 4K
results.description:
Our authentic Royal Dansk Butter Cookies are the crispy, buttery delicacies often passed around in a classic blue tin amongst loved ones. Deeply rooted in Danish baking traditions, using only the finest ingredients, our butter cookie’s delicate richness captures the spirit of everyday moments, any season and festive gatherings. Their signature shape, texture, look and aroma, are truly inviting. From the iconic Vanilla Ring to the Coconut Cookie to the pure buttery goodness of the Pretzel, there is something for everyone in the iconic blue tin.

No matter which delicious style is your favorite, there is no mistaking the one-of-a-kind crispy, melt-in-your-mouth taste of Royal Dansk butter cookies. These moments of enjoyment with Royal Dansk are the nostalgic food experiences you remember your whole life. One bite instantly brings you back to happy memories.

results.name: Capses de galetes Birba de Daniel Birba
results.description:
**CAT** Capses de llauna que l’empresa Galetes Camprodon feia servir entre els anys 40 i 70 com a recipient per a les galetes que comercialitzava. Són dues de les capses que Daniel Birba encara conserva i que formen part de la col·lecció creada gràcies al programa “Una altra història”: https://bit.ly/UAH_Capitol6.

**ES** Cajas de lata que la empresa Galetes Camprodon usaba entre los años 40 i 70 como recipiente para las galletas que comercializaba. Son dos de las cajas que Daniel Birba aún conserva y que forman parte de la colección creada gracias al programa “Una altra història”: https://bit.ly/UAH_Capitol6.

**EN** Tin boxes that the company Galetes Camprodon used between the 1940s and 1970s as containers for their cookies. These are two of the boxes that Daniel Birba still preserves and are part of the collection created due to "Una altra història": https://bit.ly/UAH_Capitol6.

Model: Laia Tubio i Rubén González. Text: Helena Meix
